reasons.detail: R1 — `flow resume` now uses `discoverRecoveryFlows()` and only exposes discovery metadata, while active continuation/resolution is not switched to scan-all flow discovery in this path.

R2 — Candidates are explicitly classified into `active`, `stale`, `finalized`, `orphan-worktree`, and `branch-only` with state derived from active-registry membership, finalized marker, worktree location, and branch source.
R3 — `senti flow resume --spec` selects a candidate only when `continuable` is true (active/orphan-worktree plus `runId` and `executionRoot`), otherwise returns `RESUME_TARGET_NOT_CONTINUABLE`.
R7 — A git-worktree recovery scenario is added with real `git worktree add` discovery and verifies worktree candidate selection plus non-active behavior at main worktree (`status` remains inactive).

R8 — Discovery now returns bounded metadata from `SCAN_FLOWS_LIMIT` with truncation flag and keeps traversal through local specs/worktree roots/branch candidates, while branch-only tests assert feature-branch filtering behavior.

R4 — `flow resume --spec` now returns the selected candidate’s `executionRoot` and `runId` with guarded continuation guidance using `--expect-run-id`, and the added contract tests assert `ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH` for status/next-action/run when runId mismatches before side effects, including in recovered execution-root scenarios.

R5 — The update removes unqualified `/senti.flow` guidance from `senti.flow-resume` and replaces it with execution-root/runId guarded continuation guidance, and adds a test asserting selected candidates return `executionRoot` plus `continueFrom` containing the runId while finalized/missing-guard scenarios produce safe-stop messaging.

R6 — The diff adds recovery discovery/selection in flow-manager + run-resume, preserves normal status behavior, enforces expect-run-id parity for status/next-action/run, keeps resolve-context unchanged for active flow, avoids registering display-only candidates in active-flow registry, and updates resume guidance docs; corresponding tests assert each listed retained surface.
